Create an 8-second hyper-authentic vertical 9:16 TikTok Shop product video using the supplied base frame as the exact visual reference for composition, environment, lighting, camera position and product placement.

CAMERA LOCK: The camera is a fixed first-person POV camera representing the viewer's eyes. Keep the exact same angle, focal length, horizon, framing and background alignment from start to finish. No camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no reframing, no perspective drift and no cinematic orbit.

NO MODEL: No model, face, head, body, shoulders, torso, legs, reflection of a person or full human figure may appear. The only visible human elements are exactly one pair of female hands and, only when necessary, a small portion of the same forearms.

HAND INTEGRITY: Exactly two hands total, belonging to the same person. Never generate extra hands, duplicated hands, background hands, phantom hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, morphing fingers, changing skin tone, changing nails or sudden hand replacement. Maintain stable anatomy, hand scale, nail style and skin tone throughout the entire shot.

PRODUCT LOCK: Preserve the product exactly as shown in the base frame and product reference. Do not alter the label, logo, text placement, colors, bottle shape, cap, package structure, scale, material, proportions or silhouette. No product morphing, melting, warping, duplication, replacement or identity drift.

PHYSICAL MECHANICS: All hand and object interactions must obey realistic physics. The product can only move when physically held or touched by the visible hands. If a cap is opened, one visible hand must clearly grip and remove or rotate it with a continuous physically plausible motion. The cap may never float, self-open, teleport, disappear, pass through the bottle or change shape. If a box is opened, the visible hands must perform the opening through the real lid, flap, hinge or fold. No ghost opening and no impossible packaging movement.

ACTION RULE: Perform only one simple primary product action during this 8-second clip. Examples: hold and present the label, gently rotate the product, lift it from the box, open the cap correctly, place the cap down, or reposition the product. Complete the action naturally before starting another. Avoid chaotic gestures and overlapping actions.

STYLE: Keep the scene elegant, realistic, premium and organic, like polished UGC rather than a heavy commercial. Keep the product as the visual priority. Use natural, controlled hand motion and subtle realistic product-handling sounds.

NO GRAPHICS: No on-screen text, subtitles, captions, price labels, interface elements, stickers, watermarks or added graphic overlays.

VOICE: Use one natural Brazilian Portuguese female voice. Deliver the provided dialogue conversationally, persuasively and at a normal human speaking speed. Do not rush or compress the speech to force extra words into 8 seconds. The dialogue must finish completely before the clip ends. Synchronize the hand action naturally with the spoken line.

FINAL PRIORITY ORDER: 1) fixed POV camera, 2) no model, 3) exactly one pair of hands, 4) anatomically stable hands, 5) exact product identity, 6) physically correct cap and packaging mechanics, 7) complete natural voiceover within 8 seconds.
